## Tech workers

Implement the interventions where you build: viral friction before resharing; perception-gap-aware ranking; empathy and context features; harms made transparent; a crisis playbook with blackout options. Study Wikipedia's model and Taiwan's civic tech as existence proofs that collaborative truth-seeking scales. Humility is the engineering requirement here: systems that admit their bias outperform systems that deny it.
